name: MimicChest
identity: Closed ochre-gold wooden treasure chest, arched lid, two broad gray iron bands, small central GOLD latch/padlock on front, black plank seams and grain. No eyes, teeth, tongue, arms or legs. Original alternate state is an open chest with the same hinged lid; do not invent shattered debris.

view_notes.Up: Axial rear: iron bands continue across curved lid, plain rear wooden box panel and two hinge attachments; front lock is hidden.
view_notes.Down: Axial front: centered small GOLD lock below the seam, rounded lid aligns with box base; no visible side face.
view_notes.motion: Legless box uses small connected whole-body rocking, no limb gait.
